relationships.evidence: we introduce ScienceAgentBench, which aims to evaluate agents on essential tasks in a data-driven discovery workflow. Before automating the entire workflow end-to-end, we envision language agents to first serve as science co-pilots that can write code to process, analyze, and visualize data. (Section 2)
